text:
sara-chen: quick follow-up from today's all-hands runtime segment. two things to nail down here: 1) kernel v5 canary timeline and gating criteria; 2) immediate mitigations for the kv-cache eviction spikes that affected low-latency pools. i'll collect answers here so i can send a short customer-facing follow-up.

jason-roberts: kernel-v5 PHASE: we have three blocking perf tests (kv-stability, tail-p99, and memory-bump). if they pass, plan: tiny canary in us-west-2 tomorrow morning (single pool), expand to cross-region small canary 48h later. gating: no eviction > 0.06 sustained for 10m, p99 delta < 8%, and no OOMs. i'll post canary id when it starts.

deploy-bot: Canary queued: kernel-v5 | canary-id=kv5-2024-09 | region=us-west-2 | status=queued.

anita-garcia: eviction spike root-cause notes: correlated with sudden influx of long-prefix requests that bypass prefix cache and force KV reshuffle. short-term mitigations that ops can apply without code change: bump pool reserve fraction and enable prefix folding window. these reduce churn and buy time for the kernel heuristic fix.

trevor-moss: batching note: dynamic microbatching improved p99 in our sim runs. short-term recommendation for low-latency pools: dynamic_microbatch: true + target_batch_size: 24-32 (start 32). it smooths bursts without raising p50. we'll add a per-pool auto-tuner next sprint.

maya-singh: i've surfaced the eviction/seq_len heatmap here: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/runtime/eviction-heatmap (runtime leads only). permission issues? DM me.

anita-garcia: ops config snippet we used in the mitigation deploy (rollout per-pool):
```yaml
pool_overrides:
  - pool_name: low-latency-1
    reserve_fraction: "0.35"
    dynamic_microbatch: "true"
    target_batch_size: "32"
    prefix_fold_window_secs: "3600"
```

jason-roberts: kernel heuristic fix summary: change alloc predictor to bias towards smaller initial KV allocations when there is high variance in observed seq_len. low-risk C change, included in the v5 canary. rollback path: flip predictor flag to legacy mode. i'll open PR and link canary job.

deploy-bot: Canary started: canary-id=kv5-2024-09 in us-west-2 | status=running.

maya-singh: temporary alert added: runtime.eviction_rate > 0.08 for 5m -> notify #eng-runtime. will adjust thresholds after canary.

sara-chen: thanks all. jason/anita/trevor 12 can you: 1) post PRs/runbooks for the heuristic tweak + ops config by EOD Friday; 2) include explicit rollback steps and the watchdog metrics to monitor. i'll draft the customer note after i review. scheduling a 30m follow-up tomorrow to review canary telemetry and decide rollout cadence. calendar invite in ~10m. :calendar:
